description: End-to-end 5G UDR (Unified Data Repository) fault management workflow covering detection, diagnosis, remediation, change management, and rollback.

udr_instance_id.description: Unique identifier of a UDR instance within the 5G core network.

fault_id.description: Unique identifier for a UDR-related fault or alarm.

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for a fault incident lifecycle record.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a change request impacting UDR configuration or data.

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier of a predefined or dynamically generated rollback plan.

user_context.description: Information about the operator or system invoking the workflow.

tenant.description: Tenant or operational domain (for multi-tenant environments).

trace_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing operations across systems.

functions.name: list_udr_instances
functions.description: List UDR instances and their high-level health for a given domain or cluster.

labels.description: Arbitrary key/value labels, matched as subset.

include_details.description: Whether to include detailed metrics and configuration summaries.

functions.returns: Paginated list of UDR instances with basic health status, capacity indicators, and optional configuration summaries.

functions.name: detect_udr_faults
functions.description: Run fault detection against one or more UDR instances using metrics, logs, and thresholds.

udr_instance_ids.description: List of UDR instance IDs to scan for faults. If empty, auto-discovery is used.

from.description: Start of the observation window in ISO 8601.

to.description: End of the observation window in ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

custom_thresholds.description: Optional overrides for specific metric thresholds.

include_existing_open_faults.description: If true, also returns currently open faults for the same instances.

functions.returns: List of newly detected UDR faults (with fault_ids if persisted) and optionally existing open faults for the specified UDR instances.

functions.name: get_fault_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details for a specific UDR fault, including topology impact and history.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response.

redact_sensitive.description: Redact sensitive fields (e.g., subscriber-related keys) from logs and metrics.

functions.returns: Comprehensive fault record with symptoms, KPIs, topology impact, historical occurrences, and correlation to other faults/incidents.

functions.name: create_fault_incident
functions.description: Create or update an incident record for one or more UDR faults, grouping related alarms.

related_fault_ids.description: Additional fault IDs suspected to be part of the same incident.

impact_assessment.description: Assessment of impact on subscribers and network functions.

estimated_affected_count.description: Estimated number of affected subscribers or sessions.

affected_nfs.description: Impacted network functions (e.g., SMF, AMF, PCF).

initial_notes.description: Free-text notes about the incident context and hypothesis.

existing_incident_id.description: If provided, attaches the fault to an existing incident instead of creating a new one.

functions.returns: Incident record with a unique incident_id, consolidated fault list, severity, and initial triage metadata.

functions.name: diagnose_udr_fault
functions.description: Perform automated diagnosis on a UDR fault/incident using rules and ML models to suggest root cause.

analysis_sources.description: Which data sources to use in the diagnosis.

hypothesis_constraints.description: Optional constraints to focus diagnosis (e.g., suspect domains).

functions.returns: Diagnosis report with ranked root cause hypotheses, confidence scores, recommended next actions, and relevant evidence references.

functions.name: plan_udr_remediation
functions.description: Generate a structured remediation plan for a diagnosed UDR fault, including validation and guardrails.

constraints.description: Operational constraints to consider when planning remediation.

block_disruptive_actions.description: If true, disallow actions like full restart or schema rollback.

include_rollback_plan.description: If true, generate an associated rollback plan.

functions.returns: Remediation plan with ordered steps, pre-checks, post-checks, risk assessment, and optional rollback_plan_id.

functions.name: apply_udr_remediation_step
functions.description: Execute a specific step of a remediation plan against a UDR instance.

step.description: The step to execute from the remediation plan.

step_id.description: Identifier of the step in the plan.

new_value.description: New configuration value, serialized as string.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the step without executing changes.

functions.returns: Execution result for the remediation step, including success/failure status, logs, and any generated follow-up actions.

functions.name: get_udr_fault_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status and KPIs for an existing UDR fault or incident to evaluate remediation impact.

metrics_window.description: Time window to evaluate KPIs post-remediation.

functions.returns: Snapshot of fault/incident status, active alarms, and UDR KPIs for the specified window, indicating whether the issue is resolved, improving, or regressing.

functions.name: create_udr_change_request
functions.description: Create a formal change request associated with a UDR fault remediation, including approvals and scheduling.

change_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the intended change.

required_approvals.description: Roles or user IDs that must approve this change.

value.description: Role name or user_id depending on approver_type.

functions.returns: Change request record with change_request_id, linkage to incident, approval workflow state, and scheduling details.

functions.name: retry_udr_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed UDR operation (e.g., remediation step, schema change) with optional parameter overrides.

original_operation_id.description: Identifier of the original failed operation.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides to adjust behavior during retry.

action_specific.description: Action-specific parameters, opaque to the retry service.

functions.returns: New operation execution record with status, logs, and linkage to the original operation and incident.

functions.name: execute_udr_rollback
functions.description: Execute a rollback plan to revert UDR changes made during a failed or risky remediation.

safety_checks.description: Additional safety checks to perform before rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback execution result, including steps taken, success/failure status, and resulting UDR health snapshot.

functions.name: close_udr_incident
functions.description: Close an incident and associated faults when UDR service is restored or accepted as residual risk.

root_cause.description: Concise description of confirmed root cause.

update_change_requests.description: If true, automatically update related change requests to 'completed' where applicable.

functions.returns: Updated incident record with final state, closure metadata, and any linked follow-up actions.

functions.name: cancel_udr_change_request
functions.description: Cancel a pending or in-planning UDR change request associated with a fault or planned remediation.

reason_details.description: Optional free-text details explaining the cancellation.

force_cancel.description: If true, attempt to cancel even if change is already in progress (may fail).

functions.returns: Change request record with updated status and any constraints or errors encountered during cancellation.

functions.name: search_udr_faults
functions.description: Faceted search across UDR faults with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of UDR fault summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_udr_faults
functions.description: Create multiple UDR faults in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created UDR fault ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_udr_faults
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many UDR faults with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each UDR fault, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_udr_faults
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many UDR faults in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each UDR fault, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_udr_faults
functions.description: Export UDR fault datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_udr_faults
functions.description: Bulk-import UDR fault records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated UDR faults.

functions.name: subscribe_to_udr_fault_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive UDR fault lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the UDR fault.

functions.name: get_udr_fault_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a UDR fault, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the UDR fault, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_udr_fault_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for UDR faults using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the UDR fault action.

functions.name: simulate_udr_fault_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a UDR fault without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the UDR fault, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_udr_fault_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a UDR fault change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the UDR fault under change.

functions.name: decide_udr_fault_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending UDR fault approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the UDR fault.

functions.name: add_udr_fault_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a UDR fault for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the UDR fault.

functions.name: upload_udr_fault_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a UDR fault with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the UDR fault.

functions.name: create_udr_fault_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a UDR fault (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the UDR fault version captured.

functions.name: restore_udr_fault_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a UDR fault from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the UDR fault.

functions.name: get_udr_fault_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for UDR faults over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the UDR fault domain context.

functions.name: get_udr_fault_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for UDR faults combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the UDR fault context.

functions.name: create_udr_fault_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to UDR faults with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current UDR faults.

functions.name: evaluate_udr_fault_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a UDR fault in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the UDR fault.

functions.name: get_udr_fault_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a UDR fault including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the UDR fault, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_udr_fault_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a UDR fault and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the UDR fault.

functions.name: assign_udr_fault_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a UDR fault with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the UDR fault with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_udr_faults
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more UDR faults, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each UDR fault.

functions.name: compare_udr_fault_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a UDR fault with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the UDR fault, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_udr_fault_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to UDR fault operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of UDR fault operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_udr_fault_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a UDR fault and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the UDR fault, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_udr_fault
functions.description: Clone a UDR fault into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned UDR fault record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_udr_fault_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted UDR fault report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the UDR fault window covered.

functions.name: escalate_udr_fault
functions.description: Escalate a UDR fault to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the UDR fault.
